question: Will PPI YoY be 6.6% in October?
literal_rule: Final-demand PPI for the 12 months ending October 2026, not seasonally adjusted (NSA), as reported by the monthly BLS PPI report. Resolution uses the report’s one-decimal percentage; total final demand, not core. Scheduled first release Nov. 13, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET. If not released then, market may remain open until the next PPI report; if still unavailable, it resolves using the most recent previous month with available data.

september_2026_release.core_comparator: final demand less foods, energy, and trade services: 5.0% over 12 months; not the resolving series

matching_nsa_series.adjustment: not seasonally adjusted (BLS documents wpu prefix as NSA)
matching_nsa_series.revision_footnote: BLS API marks Sep 2026 preliminary; all indexes subject to monthly revisions up to four months after original publication.
matching_nsa_series.interpretation: The Sep/Sep index ratio rounds to the release headline 6.3%. Oct 2025 index 150.439 is the same-reference-month prior-year base available for the future Oct 2026 comparison; index points are not themselves percent growth.

october_2025_lapse_context.BLS_statement: BLS says it did not produce a separate October 2025 PPI release because of the lapse in appropriations; October reference data were collected on delay and BLS planned to publish October data with the November 2025 PPI release on Jan. 14, 2026.
october_2025_lapse_context.series_observation: The current WPUFD4 API response includes October 2025 NSA value 150.439.

official_observations.current_delay_check: The September 2026 release was published Oct. 15 as scheduled; the captured current BLS PPI calendar lists Oct 2026 for Nov. 13, Nov 2026 for Dec. 15, and Dec 2026 for Jan. 14, 2027 (all 8:30 AM). No 2026-specific delay notice appeared in these bounded pages; future schedule disruption remains possible.

limits: October 2026 index and its first-release NSA YoY figure are not yet available. September 2026 is the latest observation and is preliminary.
Published September headline reports seasonally adjusted monthly change and unadjusted annual change; the NSA month-to-month figure above is derived from NSA index values.
No market price, probability, or outcome judgment.
